title: Trio · TimescaleDB
description: Banco transacional principal: chunks, compressao, jobs de politica e atraso dos continuous aggregates. Consulta o TimescaleDB direto (catalogo) para o que so existe la, e o Prometheus para conexoes.

panels.title: Chunks da hypertable
panels.description: 338 chunks de 1 dia. Numero relevante para o CDC: e por chunk que a decodificacao logica falhava (ver ADR).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::bigint AS "chunks" FROM timescaledb_information.chunks WHERE hypertable_name = 'transactions';

panels.title: Taxa de compressão (total)
panels.description: 5,0x no total mas 23,5x so na tabela: os 4 indices da etapa 07 pesam mais que o dado comprimido. As duas otimizacoes do desafio se pagam uma contra a outra.

panels.title: Conexões ativas
panels.description: Do postgres-exporter. Saturacao de conexao e um dos sintomas que sustentam o argumento de migracao.

panels.title: Jobs de política — compressão, retenção e refresh dos CAggs
panels.description: A retencao do raw esta DESABILITADA de proposito (scheduled=false): 90 dias contra um dataset de 12 meses apagaria dado que o desafio precisa. As dos CAggs seguem ligadas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT j.job_id, j.proc_name AS politica, j.hypertable_name AS alvo, j.scheduled AS ligado, j.schedule_interval::text AS intervalo, s.last_run_status AS ultimo_status, s.total_failures AS falhas FROM timescaledb_information.jobs j LEFT JOIN timescaledb_information.job_stats s USING (job_id) WHERE j.job_id >= 1000 ORDER BY j.job_id;

panels.title: Atraso dos continuous aggregates
panels.description: Distancia entre o watermark do CAgg e agora. Materializacao atrasada e o que torna PERIGOSO apagar chunk bruto — ver desafio-3/runbook.md.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ca.view_name AS cagg, _timescaledb_functions.to_timestamp(_timescaledb_functions.cagg_watermark(c.mat_hypertable_id)) AS materializado_ate, round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - _timescaledb_functions.to_timestamp(_timescaledb_functions.cagg_watermark(c.mat_hypertable_id))))/3600, 1) AS atraso_horas FROM timescaledb_information.continuous_aggregates ca JOIN _timescaledb_catalog.continuous_agg c ON c.user_view_name = ca.view_name ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Chunks maiores — candidatos do runbook de storage
panels.description: Ordenados por tamanho e idade. E esta lista que o runbook de storage em 92% percorre, um chunk por vez.

targets.rawSql: SELECT chunk_name, range_start::date AS inicio, is_compressed AS comprimido, pg_size_pretty(total_bytes) AS tamanho FROM timescaledb_information.chunks c JOIN LATERAL (SELECT total_bytes FROM chunks_detailed_size('transactions') d WHERE d.chunk_name = c.chunk_name) s ON true WHERE c.hypertable_name = 'transactions' ORDER BY s.total_bytes DESC LIMIT 15;

panels.title: Transações por hora (últimas 24h de dado)
panels.description: Le do CAgg horario, nao da hypertable: e a diferenca entre 3,4ms e 1.285ms (383x, medido na etapa 08).

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, type::text AS metric, sum(tx_count) AS value FROM cagg_volume_hourly WHERE bucket >= (SELECT max(bucket) - INTERVAL '24 hours' FROM cagg_volume_hourly) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;
